The '''Jin'ha starship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] used by the [[Jin'ha]] on the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Obredaan]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] for their operations in arms smuggling with the criminal organization [[Black Heth]]. Its [[Color/Legends|color]] scheme was mostly red, and had two prongs attached to the main pod that contained the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]]

*[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]
